title: Gemini Omni adds video with synchronized audio
summary:
Video with audio, model-to-Play links, and a Quest leaderboard led a day of catalog and model maintenance.

Added paid-only `google/gemini-omni-1.1-flash` video generation from text or up to two image keyframes, with synchronized audio and controls for duration, aspect ratio, and resolution up to 4K. A follow-up preserves provider failure details so content-policy refusals can be reported accurately.

Eligible model catalog rows now open the selected model in Play, which also picks the matching Image, Text, Audio, or Video tab. The community app catalog gained screenshots for 66 reviewed apps, bringing all 835 active apps into view with images; three community-built apps joined the catalog.

Community now shows the top eight Quest contributors and overall totals, based on recorded GitHub issue Quest rewards. A public leaderboard endpoint returns up to 50 contributors with their completed Quest counts and Pollen earned.

daily.title: Gemini Omni video
daily.text: Generate video with synchronized audio from text or up to two image keyframes using `google/gemini-omni-1.1-flash`. Choose a 3–10 second duration, landscape or portrait framing, and resolution up to 4K. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-omni-1.1-flash).

daily.title: Models open in Play
daily.text: Use “Try in Play” from an eligible model catalog row to open that model on the matching Image, Text, Audio, or Video tab. You can also link directly to a model with `/play?model=<id>`. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: Quest contributor leaderboard
daily.text: See the top eight Quest contributors in Community, alongside totals for completed Quests and Pollen earned.

daily.title: Quest leaderboard API
daily.text: Query `GET /api/quests/leaderboard` for up to 50 contributors ranked by Quest Pollen earned, with completed Quest counts and overall totals.
